E2_ruby_anaar2.note: A small four-point glint sits on the centre front stone: retouch it out if the ad runs large. Ruby, emerald and crystal share one layout, so run them as colour variants in one ad set.
E2_ruby_anaar2.facts: Baguette Tennis Bracelet, Ruby. ₹1,699. Ruby-red baguette cubic zirconia set crosswise in 18k gold tone plated claws, box clasp, about 17 cm.
E2_ruby_anaar2.scene: A halved pomegranate (anaar) top right, loose arils scattered, the crimson baguette bracelet in the centre on blush plaster.

E2_emerald_elaichi.note: The lower clasp sits low in the frame: keep the spec line clear of it. A colour variant of the ruby and crystal photos.
E2_emerald_elaichi.facts: Baguette Tennis Bracelet, Emerald. ₹1,699. Emerald-green baguette cubic zirconia in 18k gold tone claws.
E2_emerald_elaichi.scene: Green cardamom (elaichi) pods, a few split open showing black seeds, top right; the emerald bracelet in an S-curve on ivory.

E2_crystal_mishri2.note: The front stones read a little milky and warm up close. A colour variant of the ruby and emerald photos.
E2_crystal_mishri2.facts: Baguette Tennis Bracelet, Crystal. ₹1,699. Clear baguette cubic zirconia in 18k gold tone claws.
E2_crystal_mishri2.scene: A brass katori heaped with mishri (rock sugar) top right, loose crystals scattered, the clear baguette bracelet on beige linen.

E2_studs_mogra.note: A small glint on the right stud. A blurred flower makes the bottom-right corner busy, so give the wordmark and price a soft scrim there.
E2_studs_mogra.facts: Petal Flower Studs. ₹1,199. Each stud: three round clear cubic zirconia and one pear stone around a polished centre; 18k gold tone (also silver tone).
E2_studs_mogra.scene: Loose white mogra (jasmine) flowers and buds on sage linen; the two gold flower studs among them.

E2_mint_nimbu.note: The earrings read about three times too big against the lime and the glass. Crop tight on the earrings, or use the listing photos instead.
E2_mint_nimbu.facts: Mint Pear Drop Earrings. ₹1,499. Three small clear pear stones leading to one pale mint green pear, cubic zirconia, 18k gold tone, about 22 mm.
E2_mint_nimbu.scene: A tall glass of nimbu pani with a lime wheel and mint sprig, a halved lime beside it; the earrings in front on white plaster.

E2_tubogas_churi.note: The ring reads a little large against the bangles because it stands in front of them.
E2_tubogas_churi.facts: Tubogas Dome Ring. ₹1,399. Wide flexible ribbed tubogas band, about 10 mm, gold or silver tone, US sizes 6, 7, 8.
E2_tubogas_churi.scene: A tall stack of thin ribbed gold bangles (chudiyan) behind; the gold tubogas ring standing on a plaster block in front.

E2_watch_haath.note: The prop watch looks like a well-known luxury watch, and its dial has no hands. Crop the watch out or reshoot before running it.
E2_watch_haath.facts: Watch Link Ring. ₹1,199. Wide band built like a watch bracelet: three rows of polished links; gold or silver tone; sizes 6 to 8.
E2_watch_haath.scene: A two-tone link-bracelet wristwatch (no brand visible) lying on handmade paper; the gold watch-link ring standing in front.

E2_droplet_rain2.note: Up close the puddles at the cuff’s ends read as gel and the drops ring it too evenly. Rain is also off-season for an October–November launch.
E2_droplet_rain2.facts: Droplet Open Cuff. ₹1,899. Slim polished open cuff ending in a round ball on one end and a smooth teardrop on the other, a small gap between; gold or silver tone.
E2_droplet_rain2.scene: The gold cuff on a cool grey wet surface, ringed by scattered water droplets; the ball and teardrop ends face each other at the front.

P11_diya.note: The stones do not follow the bracelet’s aqua, pink, yellow order, and they are lit cool beside warm flames. Diwali only: stop it after 8 November.
P11_diya.facts: Prism Rivière bracelet. ₹2,399. 18 cm line of square aqua, pink and yellow cubic zirconia, each in a halo of small clear stones, silver tone.
P11_diya.scene: Three lit clay diyas top right on cream plaster; the pastel Prism bracelet curving in front of them.

P12_saree.note: A few stones show thin rims of the wrong colour at full size; on a phone they read fine. Keep copy off the clasp at bottom left. Runs through Diwali into wedding season.
P12_saree.facts: Prism Rivière bracelet. ₹2,399. 18 cm line of square aqua, pink and yellow cubic zirconia, each in a halo of small clear stones, silver tone.
P12_saree.scene: Three folded silk sarees stacked, yellow on top, pink, then aqua, with gold zari borders; the bracelet laid across them.

E2_knot_gath.note: The zari stripe crosses the top left, the weakest spot for headline contrast. Wedding season: run it now.
E2_knot_gath.facts: Kiss Knot Bangle. ₹1,499. Flexible ribbed snake-coil bangle whose two ends cross under one smooth polished X on top; gold or silver tone.
E2_knot_gath.scene: Deep red silk with a gold zari stripe, knotted at the top like a wedding gathbandhan knot; the gold bangle lying on the silk.

E2_duo_gangajamuni.note: A small glint on one link; the chain runs off the right edge twice.
E2_duo_gangajamuni.facts: Duo Link Necklace. ₹1,799. Long oval links in gold tone and silver tone mixed along the chain, joined by small gold rings; about 45 cm.
E2_duo_gangajamuni.scene: The two-tone chain curled on an engraved brass-and-silver thali (Ganga-Jamuni metalwork) in warm light.

E2_mesh_silk.note: On a phone the silk hank reads a little like raffia.
E2_mesh_silk.facts: Silk Mesh Cuff. ₹1,899. Open cuff of a rounded tube of fine woven metal mesh, about 15 mm wide, with two polished oval end caps; gold or silver tone.
E2_mesh_silk.scene: A loose hank of glossy golden silk thread (resham, the colour of zari) behind; the gold mesh cuff in front on plaster.

E2_meshring_chai.note: The ring reads a little chunky because it sits in front, and the tea-stain ring looks staged up close.
E2_meshring_chai.facts: Mesh Band Ring. ₹999. Wide band of fine woven metal mesh with rolled edges; gold or silver tone; sizes 6 to 8.
E2_meshring_chai.scene: A worn brass chai strainer (channi) holding used tea leaves, a chai-glass ring stain on the surface; the gold mesh ring in front.

E2_roman_ghadi.note: A four-point glint on the pavé band is the most visible in the set: retouch it out for large sizes. Don’t run it beside the watch photo, the other timepiece idea.
E2_roman_ghadi.facts: Roman Numeral Trio Ring. ₹1,899. Three bands fixed as one: rose gold tone with engraved Roman numerals and small stones, silver tone with two pavé rows, gold tone with cut-out Roman numerals; sizes 6 to 8.
E2_roman_ghadi.scene: A large brass clock dial with Roman numerals and hands top right; the three-tone ring standing in front.

E2_choker_monsoon.note: The long water rivulets read as sweat at phone size, and a glint sits on the marquise. Rain is off-season now.
E2_choker_monsoon.facts: Marquise Drop Choker. ₹1,599. Smooth omega collar with a marquise cubic zirconia set sideways at the front; a fine chain falls about 6 cm with a small pear halfway and another at the end; 18k gold tone.
E2_choker_monsoon.scene: Close crop of a woman's neck and collarbone (no face) with water droplets on the skin, saffron camisole strap; the choker with its marquise and two pears.

E2_huggie_jamun.note: The amethyst reads lilac, lighter than the fruit. Jamun is a summer fruit, so don’t claim a season.
E2_huggie_jamun.facts: Baguette Huggies, Amethyst. ₹1,399. Gold tone huggie hoops with one row of amethyst baguette cubic zirconia along the lower front; hinged snap.
E2_huggie_jamun.scene: A small heap of jamun fruits, one cut open showing purple flesh, a purple juice stain on cream plaster; the amethyst huggies in front.

E2_coil_jalebi.note: Up close the jalebi reads as orange jelly candy, not a crisp fried sweet. The bangle’s lowest turn sits low, so keep the spec line clear of it.
E2_coil_jalebi.facts: Triple Coil Wrap Bangle. ₹1,899 gold (₹1,799 silver). One continuous ribbed snake-coil wire wrapping the wrist in three turns, each end with a small rectangular pavé cap.
E2_coil_jalebi.scene: A brass plate of orange jalebi coils top right; the gold triple-coil bangle standing in front on ivory.

E2_tennis_phuljhadi.note: The stones read slightly milky up close, with a small glint on the right side.
E2_tennis_phuljhadi.facts: Fine Tennis Bracelet. ₹1,299. One continuous row of small round clear cubic zirconia, about 2.5 mm each, in gold tone claw cups; box clasp.
E2_tennis_phuljhadi.scene: A lit phuljhadi (sparkler) in a small brass holder throwing sparks on dark slate; the fine gold tennis bracelet in front.

E2_star_dhruv.note: The engraved stars read as eight-petal daisies, not the listing’s four-long, four-short compass star, and the cloth reads as sequins up close.
E2_star_dhruv.facts: North Star Bangle. ₹1,499. Slim flat mirror-polished bangle, its outer face alternating engraved eight-point north stars with round clear stones in flush bezels; silver or gold tone.
E2_star_dhruv.scene: Deep navy night sky dotted with tiny stars and one bright star top right; the silver bangle in front catching light.

P13_kandil.note: The front row’s stone order is wrong (aqua, pink, aqua, pink, yellow…). Diwali only: stop it after 8 November.
P13_kandil.facts: Prism Rivière bracelet. ₹2,399. 18 cm line of square aqua, pink and yellow cubic zirconia, each in a halo of small clear stones, silver tone.
P13_kandil.scene: Three glowing pastel paper star lanterns (akash kandils) in aqua, pink and yellow top right; the bracelet laid in a loop on cream below.

P11_diya_916.note: Most of the recoloured stones show a stone inside a stone, and one yellow is half white. Fix it before running. Diwali only.
P11_diya_916.facts: Prism Rivière bracelet. ₹2,399. 18 cm line of square aqua, pink and yellow cubic zirconia, each in a halo of small clear stones, silver tone.
P11_diya_916.scene: Three lit clay diyas top right on cream plaster; the pastel Prism bracelet curving in front of them.

E2_ruby_anaar2_916.note: The tightest foot in the Stories: the front prongs sit about 40 px above the spec line. A small glint, and the clasp hallmark is garbled up close.
E2_ruby_anaar2_916.facts: Baguette Tennis Bracelet, Ruby. ₹1,699. Ruby-red baguette cubic zirconia set crosswise in 18k gold tone plated claws, box clasp, about 17 cm.
E2_ruby_anaar2_916.scene: A halved pomegranate (anaar) top right, loose arils scattered, the crimson baguette bracelet in the centre on blush plaster.

E2_studs_mogra_916.note: Some open flowers read as gardenia up close, and a bud is cut off by the left edge.
E2_studs_mogra_916.facts: Petal Flower Studs. ₹1,199. Each stud: three round clear cubic zirconia and one pear stone around a polished centre; 18k gold tone (also silver tone).
E2_studs_mogra_916.scene: Loose white mogra (jasmine) flowers and buds on sage linen; the two gold flower studs among them.

E2_choker_monsoon_916.note: The rivulets read as sweat on the chest at phone size. Rain is off-season now.
E2_choker_monsoon_916.facts: Marquise Drop Choker. ₹1,599. Smooth omega collar with a marquise cubic zirconia set sideways at the front; a fine chain falls about 6 cm with a small pear halfway and another at the end; 18k gold tone.
E2_choker_monsoon_916.scene: Close crop of a woman's neck and collarbone (no face) with water droplets on the skin, saffron camisole strap; the choker with its marquise and two pears.

P13_kandil_916.note: One pink stone is two-tone and one yellow reads olive; two aquas sit side by side on the back row. Diwali only.
P13_kandil_916.facts: Prism Rivière bracelet. ₹2,399. 18 cm line of square aqua, pink and yellow cubic zirconia, each in a halo of small clear stones, silver tone.
P13_kandil_916.scene: Three glowing pastel paper star lanterns (akash kandils) in aqua, pink and yellow top right; the bracelet laid in a loop on cream below.
